name: Sarkad (Hungary)
description: White field with a blue horizontal stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the town arms of Sarkad: a shield of red, blue and white with a helm and red, yellow and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sarkad arms with helm and mantling
